dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: Hello, are you a visitor here too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this a popular tourist attraction?

dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm sorry to say that it isn't. This is just a private residence.

dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: People visit here from time to time because this place was designed by a famous architect.

dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: But it's still a private residence, so please forgive me for being unable to give you an indoor tour.

dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: Oh... I almost forgot. Please don't spread the word about this location.

dialogues.speaker: Shaghayeh
dialogues.text: While the Lord doesn't mind people taking a tour of the garden, this place was priced for the peace and quiet away from the hubbub of the world. So, I hope you understand.
